name: Which primary bathroom features matter most to luxury buyers in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: If I am remodeling for resale, what primary bathroom features do high-end Los Angeles buyers care about most?
mainEntity.text: If I am remodeling for resale, what primary bathroom features do high-end Los Angeles buyers care about most?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-end buyers in Los Angeles tend to value primary bathrooms that feel spacious, bright, and well built. The most desirable features usually include a large shower, dual vanity, quality materials, excellent lighting, and smart storage. A spa-like feeling matters, but so does practicality. Buyers notice when the room is easy to use and visually calm. A well-proportioned layout often matters more than expensive finishes alone. For resale, timeless choices usually outperform overly trendy colors or highly specialized design details. Durable tile, clean lines, strong waterproofing, and good hardware can make the bathroom feel premium without making it look dated too quickly. If the goal is resale, the remodel should align with the rest of the home and neighborhood expectations rather than chasing the most extravagant option.
